fact: The report of the AMC-MAD congress held in Antananarivo on 5-9 November 2024 records a round table, with DEPSI and DGFS taking part, finding that the electronic personal medical record is functional in some private establishments and CSB but that technical and financial obstacles slow large-scale implementation, and records a convention signed between AMC-MAD and Datasanté for continued logistic and financial support of the Datasanté computerised patient record used in community medical centres.
title: Seconde édition des journées internationales de la Médecine Générale Communautaire et du Numérique dans la Santé - Madagascar Antananarivo du 5 au 9 Novembre 2024
